# SectorCalc

> Deterministic industrial engineering calculators for machining,
> tolerances, rotating equipment, welding, pressure systems,
> bolted joints, lifting and manufacturing costing.
> SectorCalc exposes calculation methods, model boundaries,
> units, engine versions and reproducibility information so
> engineering results can be reviewed rather than treated as a black box.

## Start Here

- [Engineering Calculators](https://sectorcalc.com/tools): Browse all active engineering calculators.
- [Engineering Topics](https://sectorcalc.com/topics): Find calculators by engineering decision area.
- [Calculation Guides](https://sectorcalc.com/guides): Review formulas, methods, examples and model boundaries.
- [Engineering Glossary](https://sectorcalc.com/glossary): Definitions, symbols, units and technical concepts.
- [Pricing](https://sectorcalc.com/pricing): One-time calculation credits with no subscription.

## Open Reference Calculators

- [Weld Throat Thickness & Joint Sizing Calculator](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/weld-thickness): Throat and leg look interchangeable until the drawing review rejects the callout.
- [Fits & Clearances Calculator — ISO 286](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/iso-286-fits): H7/g6 looks familiar — until someone asks for the actual limit deviations.
- [Surface Finish Converter — Ra, Rz, RMS](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/surface-finish): Drawing calls out Ra — shop measures Rz. Which number do you release?
- [Sheet Metal Bend Allowance & K-Factor Calculator](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/sheet-metal-bend): Flat pattern wrong by a few millimetres means the brake setup already failed.
- [Sheet Metal Punching Force & Die Clearance Calculator](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/punching-force): Press tonnage guessed from habit is how punches snap and frames ring.

## Core Decision Calculators

- [Tolerance Stack-Up Calculator — Worst-Case & RSS](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/tolerance-stack-up): SC-008 — ADVANCED · 15 credits · 24h session. Deterministic 1D tolerance stack-up with worst-case, RSS, and seeded Monte Carlo (10,000 iterations). Predicted Cpk, PPM, and full A1-A5 audit trail. Client-side only.
- [True Labor Burden Rate Calculator](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/true-labor-cost): SC-010 — CORE · 3 credits · 24h session. True loaded labor cost with statutory burden, benefits, overhead, and indirect time. Deterministic.
- [Manufacturing Quote & Part Costing Calculator](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/quote-pricing): SC-012 — PRO · 7 credits · 24h session. Quote pricing with material, labor, overhead, markup, and margin analysis. Deterministic audit trail.
- [CNC Feeds & Speeds Calculator — Milling & Turning](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/cnc-feeds-speeds): SC-020 — ADVANCED · 15 credits · 24h session. Calculate cutting speed, feed rate, and Taylor tool life with chip thinning and deterministic Decimal engine. Full audit trail. Client-side only.
- [Bearing Life L10 Calculator — ISO 281](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/bearing-life-l10): SC-021 — PRO · 7 credits · 24h session. ISO 281 bearing life calculator with aISO adjustment, viscosity ratio kappa, and contamination factor eC. Deterministic audit trail.
- [Cycle Time & Machining Cost Per Part Calculator](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/cycle-time-cost): SC-023 — CORE · 3 credits · 24h session. Calculate true cycle time, setup burden, and cost per good part with scrap rate and deterministic engine.
- [Welding Heat Input & Cooling Time t8/5 Calculator](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/weld-heat-input): SC-029 — ADVANCED · 15 credits · 24h session. Calculate welding heat input and cooling time t8/5 for WPS/PQR screening. Deterministic engine.
- [Pressure Vessel Shell Thickness Calculator — ASME VIII](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/pressure-vessel-shell): SC-033 — ADVANCED · 15 credits · 24h session. ASME Section VIII Division 1 internal pressure shell thickness calculator. Deterministic audit trail.
- [Pipe Wall Thickness Calculator — ASME B31.3](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/pipe-wall-thickness): SC-034 — ADVANCED · 15 credits · 24h session. ASME B31.3 pipe wall thickness and MAWP calculator with corrosion allowance and mill tolerance.
- [Bolt Torque & Preload Calculator — VDI 2230](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/bolt-torque-preload): SC-035 — PRO · 7 credits · 24h session. VDI 2230 bolt torque and preload calculator with friction coefficients and tightening factor.
- [Bolted Joint Calculator — VDI 2230](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/bolted-joint): SC-036 — ADVANCED · 15 credits · 24h session. Bolted joint verification with axial stiffness, preload, and clamping force analysis per VDI 2230.
- [Machine Hourly Rate Calculator](https://sectorcalc.com/calculator/machine-hour-rate): SC-038 — CORE · 3 credits · 24h session. True machine hour rate with depreciation, maintenance, power, and overhead allocation. Deterministic.

## Glossary

- [Tolerance Stack-Up](https://sectorcalc.com/glossary/tolerance-stack-up): 1D linear analysis that sums dimensional contributors to predict gap or interference risk.
- [RSS Tolerance](https://sectorcalc.com/glossary/rss-tolerance): Root-sum-square statistical stack method used when contributors are treated as independent.
- [Worst-Case Analysis](https://sectorcalc.com/glossary/worst-case-analysis): Arithmetic extreme-material stack that assumes every contributor sits at its legal extreme.
- [ISO 286 Fits](https://sectorcalc.com/glossary/iso-286-fits): Hole and shaft tolerance zones whose limit deviations change with diameter band.
- [ISO 281](https://sectorcalc.com/glossary/iso-281): International basis for rolling-bearing dynamic load ratings and basic rating life.
- [Bearing L10 Life](https://sectorcalc.com/glossary/bearing-l10-life): Basic rating life at which 90% of a bearing population is expected to survive under stated load.
- [CNC Feeds and Speeds](https://sectorcalc.com/glossary/cnc-feeds-and-speeds): Surface speed, spindle RPM, feed per tooth, and material-removal rate for a stable cut.
- [Process Capability Cpk](https://sectorcalc.com/glossary/process-capability-cpk): Capability index that compares process spread and centering against specification limits.
- [VDI 2230 Bolted Joint](https://sectorcalc.com/glossary/vdi-2230-bolted-joint): Guideline framework for bolted-joint verification including stiffness and load sharing.
- [Machine Hour Rate](https://sectorcalc.com/glossary/machine-hour-rate): Shop rate that recovers ownership, operating, and overhead cost per productive machine hour.
